question: If 50\% of 60\% of (2)/(7) of a number is 618 , find the number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentages to fractions: 50% = 1/2 and 60% = 3/5.

Fractional product = 1/2 × 3/5 × 2/7 = 3/35 of the number.

Given: 3 units = 618

1 unit = 618 ÷ 3 = 206

Number (35 units) = 206 × 35 = 7210.

**∴ The correct answer is 7210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

50% of 60% of 2/7 of a number = 618

**Formula Used:**

x% of y = (x/100) × y

 Original Number (x) 2/7 Part 
• 60% (3/5) of 2/7 50% (1/2) of 60% of 2/7 
 3/35 of x = 618 x = 7210 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the number be x.

⇒ (50/100) × (60/100) × (2/7) × x = 618

⇒ (1/2) × (3/5) × (2/7) × x = 618

⇒ (3/35) × x = 618

⇒ x = (618 × 35) ÷ 3

⇒ x = 206 × 35

⇒ x = 7210

**∴ The correct answer is 7210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To simplify calculations, memorize standard fractions: 25% = 1/4, 33.33% = 1/3, 40% = 2/5, 75% = 3/4, 80% = 4/5.

Successive Percentage Application

When multiple percentages are applied to a single base value, they can be multiplied directly as fractions: Total fraction = f₁ × f₂ × f₃.

Finding the Base Number

If a fraction (a/b) of a number is equal to V, then the original number is (V × b) ÷ a.
